tool.identity_source: Exact existing scip-go binary rehashed2026-10-18 without execution; matching bytes retain the BuildInfo identity previously recorded in T511/T521 preparation, not their quality results

source_handling: Copy each frozen selected source module unchanged into a new owned scratch root. Public is selected3Go files, not complete upstream Cadence; neutral is7authored files. Add only generated index.scip and evaluator go.sum; reject changed original bytes or unexpected additions. No frozen source/label/prereg/witness edits. Upstream Git pins remain provenance, not evaluator index commits.

limits.children: one indexer root at a time; serialize with all native/build/browser work
limits.failure: Record the first timeout, missing cached dependency or source/input refusal. Kill/drain the owned group when required and join root; stop subsequent populations. No automatic fetch, retry, source/label rewrite or candidate scoring.
